description: This Java source file defines the InternalExternalEventService class, which manages external event data in the Fineract project. It includes methods for deleting events, retrieving events with filters, and converting raw event data into readable formats, utilizing reflection and JSON processing.

classes.name: InternalExternalEventService
classes.description: Service class for managing external events, including retrieval, deletion, and data conversion.
